overall_reason: The WebGL game is the content, but the page carries no HTML text at all, has no poster or fallback without script, and loads a 2.2 MB music track before the visitor starts.

score.reason: T-NO-SCRIPT fails with no text in the DOM (ROB-015), T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB fails at 5698 KiB (ROB-018) and T-TRANSLATE fails on the canvas title (ROB-011).

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.where: Whole page, all widths, tiles/1440-00.png and tiles/375-00.png
findings.evidence: resilience.hidden_content: visible_chars 0 and total_chars 0 in every condition (baseline, reduced motion, observer never fires, scripts off); fonts.json drew no text. The title 'MESSENGER' and the start button are geometry in the canvas (tiles/375-00.png).
findings.before: Everything, including the title and the start button, exists only inside the WebGL canvas.
findings.after: Put an HTML title, a one-line description and a start button over a poster image, and show a message when script or WebGL is missing.
findings.why: Without script, without WebGL or before the assets arrive, the visitor sees a blank teal screen with no name and no way in.

findings.title: Weight fits the page's job
findings.evidence: performance: 5698 KiB known across 108 requests (transfer_kib fail; budget 1500 to 3000). The heaviest file is bgmusic-highq.ogg at 2257 KiB, then App3D JS 493 KiB, planet.drc 329 KiB, the basis transcoder 227 KiB and a 217 KiB font. LCP was not measured because nothing in the DOM paints.
findings.before: The page loads the high-quality music track with the scene, before the visitor presses start.
findings.after: Load the music after the first interaction, start with a low-quality stream, and load the 3D assets the intro needs first.
findings.why: Weight is the content of a game, but 2.2 MB of audio buys nothing until sound plays, and on a phone line it delays the planet.

findings.title: Room for other languages
findings.evidence: The title 'MESSENGER' is built from 3D blocks and the yellow start button label is drawn in the canvas; the DOM holds no text to translate (language.scripts_share is empty).
findings.before: The only words on the screen are set in geometry.
findings.after: Mirror the title and the start label in HTML so translation, screen readers and search can reach them.
findings.why: No translation tool, screen reader or search engine can read the name of the piece or the label of its only action.

strengths: The canvas fills each viewport with no sideways scroll, and the 375 layout recomposes the title for a phone (tiles/375-00.png).
html lang is set to en.
